scope: The complete, immutable, frozen HG002 v5.0q primary external evaluation -- from raw BAM through final evaluation report. Opened exactly once (decision 0048). Does NOT include the NIST SV v0.6 secondary/sensitivity pass (separate, not yet run) or the untouched multi-person cohort (separate, not yet run).

source URL + expected size (provenance)

entries.purpose: Master GRCh38 reference used throughout this project (3,366 contigs)
Master reference faidx index
BAM-compatible subset reference (2,580 contigs, exact match to HG002 BAM header)
Subset reference faidx index

exact subset-reference construction command + verification
entries.command: samtools view -H HG002.GRCh38.60x.1.bam | awk -F'\t' '/^@SQ/{for(i=1;i<=NF;i++) if($i ~ /^SN:/) print substr($i,4)}' > HG002_bam_contigs.txt ; samtools faidx GRCh38_full.fa $(cat HG002_bam_contigs.txt) > GRCh38_HG002_subset.fa ; samtools faidx GRCh38_HG002_subset.fa
entries.verification: contig-name set of GRCh38_HG002_subset.fa.fai diffed against HG002_bam_contigs.txt (both sorted) -- confirmed byte-identical, 2,580/2,580 names match
